en.title: Roar of the Asphalt: Full Court Climax
en.premise: Retsu is a boy who traded his "obsession with victory" in a black market that buys and sells memories. Having lost his past glory and passion, he is led by a nameless stray cat and dives back into the world of street basketball. The only way to reclaim his lost memories is to claim the title of the pinnacle. On a court where sweat and screams intertwine, the battle to retake his soul begins.

zh.title: 沥青的咆哮：全场决胜巅峰
zh.premise: 少年烈在买卖记忆的黑市中，典当了自己对胜利的执着。曾经的荣耀与热情荡然无存，他却在一只无名流浪猫的引导下，再次跃入街头篮球的世界。找回失落记忆的唯一方法，便是夺下巅峰之名。在汗水与呐喊交织的球场上，灵魂的夺回之战正式拉开帷幕。
